title: Inner Light · morning promo · 04-sits-up
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 film, 35mm look, soft natural grain, natural light only. Muted palette with periwinkle and slate-blue tones, warm haze, never clinical white. One person alone, unhurried, eyes closed or turned from the lens, never smiling at camera. Camera barely moves: a slow push-in or a held frame, no whip pans. Any phone in shot is an ordinary smartphone with a dim, unreadable screen. No text, no logos, no subtitles. The same woman sets the smartphone face-down on the nightstand and sits up on the edge of the bed, bare feet on the floor, shoulders soft, looking toward the window as the light fills the room. Held frame.
